create.name: Peter Sterios
create.bio:
Peter Sterios is a yoga teacher, trainer and architect who divides his time between San Luis Obispo on California's central coast and the north of New Zealand's South Island. He came to yoga as a young man and spent two decades studying closely with one teacher. When he broke his back at 39 and faced major surgery, he could no longer lean on the physical methods he knew, and his practice turned inward; from that period came the two ideas that shape his teaching, gravity and grace. He later founded the yoga mat company Manduka, taught yoga at the White House for three years in the Obama era, and works as an architect on yoga studios and retreat buildings.

His method, which he calls LEVITYoGA, asks students to follow the subtle sensations of the body rather than copy set shapes, so that each person learns to hear an inner teacher. He gives weekly classes in San Luis Obispo, live online trainings of 50 and 100 hours, recorded workshops and retreats in the United States and Europe. His Gravity & Grace DVDs were singled out by Yoga Journal, and his 2019 book of the same name, which won a Nautilus gold medal, sets out the approach on the mat and in daily life.

courses.title: In-Person Yoga with Peter Sterios (San Luis Obispo)
courses.description: A Saturday morning flow class at the Body+Balance Center in San Luis Obispo, offered as drop-ins or short seasonal series. The practice moves between dynamic and still work.

courses.title: MIND+ MOTION Trainings (INNERteacher Academy)
courses.description: Live online trainings of 50 or 100 hours, run once a year, that teach students to read their own bodies through the principles of gravity and grace rather than learn more poses. There is a waitlist for the next intake.

courses.title: Online Workshop – Gravity & Grace (REPLAY)
courses.description: A recorded workshop on yielding to gravity and moving by intuition, with practice on smooth transitions and finer awareness of weight and balance. Suitable for all levels and streamed on Vimeo after purchase.

courses.title: G&G 1 | Yoga for Finding Your Inner Teacher DVD (186m)
courses.description: His first practice DVD, made in 2007, with an all-levels routine that can be adjusted day to day and optional harder sequences. Extra chapters explain the principles of LEVITYoGA and include interviews with him.

courses.title: G&G 2 | Yoga for Longevity DVD (110m)
courses.description: The second Gravity & Grace practice DVD, built from opening, flexibility, strength and closing sequences. It is also sold as single downloads on his shop.
